681-5411-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5411-6621-8345.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat from step 2.

500-3125-4050-4826-4867.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
500-3125-4050-4826-4867.description:

Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cormela token, adding one mana.
When the Cormela token dies, it triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, entering untapped due to Archelos.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Cormela triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
